principles: Topology is the residue of the learning loop; loop quality determines topology quality (IAL proposal)
The substrate must not write the lift file itself (IAL 27.3.c.4); it did (lift-status.json authored by agent)
S3 must not be a gate: a gate makes the substrate optimize for appearing ready (IAL tasks 27.S.6)
Tractable from this spec alone: none; more iteration is documentation drift (IAL tasks 2026-05-02)
Three layers, no smuggling: deterministic code, activities constrain, LLM only where needed (ias-executor-as-canonical-host)
Activities ARE tests; traces ARE test results (harness-as-lifecycle-participant)
Every lifecycle emit ships with a default subscriber (audit F4)
Audit filters must report total_pre_filter with the filtered count (audit F14)
One container is one substrate; a container is a valid trust boundary (single-container design)
Closure: every lift property derives from substrate-resident vessels alone (substrate-closure-properties via IAL)
Fail loud with a typed failure_mode; no silent fall-through to a defunct deployment (identity-resolution)
A verified patch is parked, not discarded; recurrence is a gap event, not a journal grep (specs/parked-landing)
Restart by age of in-flight work, not count of busy observations (specs/restart-budgets)
